rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact: price is far below session VWAP ($32.29) and below the rolling 5-min VWAP, the sequence since entry shows persistent lower highs (30.43→30.39→30.37→30.34) with the heaviest volume on down bars (16.1K and 10.6K), and the trade has never gone underwater beyond -0.03% while grinding toward the $30.00 target near session lows. The bounce off 30.26-30.27 and a strong SPY tape (+0.91%) pose late-day squeeze risk, but that is not enough evidence to abandon the position — and it is certainly not stronger evidence for a counter-trend long, so flipping is unwarranted. Risk/reward from here (~$0.32 stop risk vs ~$0.34 reward) stays acceptable with the $30.66 invalidation untouched.
